title: Great looking and functional lunch cooler/bag
text: Great looking and functional lunch cooler/bag. Great bag to take to school or the office. Nice size with compartments. Fashionable (I got the red color) and fits easily under my desk. I packed lunch and a bottle of water and everything stayed cool and fresh for the 5 hours it was under my desk (insulated well). I even took this to the beach last weekend for a day out and everything surprisingly stayed cool there as well. Highly recommend for either kids for school, adults for office or even to the beach or park to keep foods cool.
